HomePage.subtitle: Securely process your PDF files directly in your browser. Your documents never leave your device.

features.privateDesc: Files are processed locally on your device. No uploads to servers.
features.noLimitsDesc: Process as many files as you need without size restrictions.
features.freeDesc: No accounts, no subscriptions, no hidden fees.

why.title: Why Use PDFinery?
why.description: All processing happens in your browser. Your files never leave your device—no uploads to our servers, no installation, and no account required. PDFinery is a free, secure PDF merger and reorder tool that works on any device with a modern web browser.

organize.title: Organize
organize.description: Merge multiple PDF files into one document. Reorder pages with drag and drop, and remove unwanted pages.

split.title: Split
split.description: Split PDF into multiple files by range, extract specific pages, or split into single pages.

convert.title: Convert PDF
convert.description: Securely convert PDF to JPG/PNG images, extract text from PDFs, or convert images and text to PDF directly in your browser.

sign.title: Sign & Secure
sign.description: Sign documents with your personal signature. Draw, type, or upload your signature image.

edit.title: Edit
edit.description: Edit your PDF by adding text, drawing, shapes, and images directly on the pages.

optimize.title: Optimize
optimize.description: Compress and optimize your PDF files. Reduce file size and remove metadata.

howTo.title: How to use
howTo.step1: Upload your PDF, image (JPG/PNG), or text file to our secure converter
howTo.step2: Choose your conversion format (PDF to Image, PDF to Text, or Convert to PDF)
howTo.step3: Adjust conversion settings such as image format (PNG/JPG) and quality scale
howTo.step4: Click 'Convert' and preview your converted files or ZIP archive
howTo.step5: Click 'Download' to download your converted files or ZIP archive

list.0: Convert PDF to JPG and PNG images with high-resolution quality
list.1: Accurately extract text from PDF documents to plain text files (.txt)
list.2: Convert images (JPG/PNG) and text files into formatted multi-page PDFs
list.3: Batch convert PDFs and download all pages as a convenient ZIP file
list.4: Completely free PDF converter with no hidden fees or file size limits
list.5: Maximum security: 100% client-side processing, your files are never uploaded
